summary: National Grid plc filed a Form 6-K to incorporate by reference into its existing F-3 shelf registration statement the underwriting agreement and supplemental indenture for its issuance of $750 million 5.405% Notes due 2036, underwritten by Morgan Stanley, SMBC Nikko, TD Securities, and Wells Fargo. This is a routine debt offering under an existing shelf, not a special-situation event. No unusual terms, structural changes, or strategic actions are present. No further analysis warranted.
